# Burrow v0.2.1 — Smart Scan by Default

Burrow v0.2.1 is a focused maintenance release that improves the first-launch
experience and corrects the application icon on macOS 26. 🐹

## Highlights

- **✨ Smart Scan first** — Burrow now opens directly on Smart Scan while the
  live system dashboard remains available from the State tab.
- **🎨 Native macOS icon treatment** — the application icon now uses an opaque,
  full-bleed canvas so macOS 26 applies its standard rounded mask without the
  grey legacy enclosure.
- **🖼️ Updated project preview** — the README now presents the Smart Scan
  workflow with the latest application screenshot.
- **🧹 Safer binary thinning cleanup** — failed final installation of a thinned
  application no longer leaves a hidden intermediate copy in Applications.

## Platform

- macOS 13 Ventura or later
- Apple Silicon only (`arm64`)

## Integrity

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and CycloneDX dependency inventories.
See `SHA256SUMS` in the downloadable artifacts before installation.

Burrow remains pre-1.0 software. Review the proposed actions and keep current
backups before using maintenance features on important data.
